te: Pope Clement VI issues the papal bull Unigenitus, laying out the scriptural justification for indulgences, identifying …
dz: 教皇克莱门特六世颁布了教皇训令 Unigenitus，列出了赎罪券的圣经依据，仅确定教皇和主教有权获得功德宝库，并每半个世纪设立一个禧年。
de: Pope Clement VI issues the papal bull Unigenitus, laying out the scriptural justification for indulgences, identifying only the Pope and episcopate as capable of accessing the treasury of merit, and establishing a jubilee year every half century.

de: Arnošt of Pardubice becomes the last Bishop of Prague (3 March 1343 O.S.), and, a year later, the first Archbishop of Prague.
